description: Declarative Layer-2 builder for an ordered CHOP processing chain. Pass an `ops` list (type + optional name + optional params); each op[i] is wired output 0 → input 0 of op[i+1] under `parent` (default `/project1`). Per-op create/param/connect failures become warnings (fail-forward) — a partial chain still returns useful info. Tip: end the chain in a `nullCHOP` to make it `bind_to_channel`-ready.

name.description: Base name for the chain; used as a name prefix when ops omit `name`, and as the chain's reported id.

ops.description: Ordered list of CHOPs. Each op[i] is wired output 0 → input 0 of op[i+1].

name.description: Optional explicit node name. Defaults to '<name>_<i>_<typeStem>' (the type with trailing CHOP stripped).

params.description: Parameter name → value map applied after creation. A string value matching an earlier op's name resolves to that op's absolute path.

type.description: CHOP operator type (e.g. `audiofileinCHOP`, `mathCHOP`, `lagCHOP`, `filterCHOP`, `nullCHOP`). Must end with `CHOP`.

name: build_chop_chain
title: Build CHOP chain
